name: Officer’s Strike (Combat)
body:
You mete out divine punishment through your fists.

Prerequisite(s): Office class feature.

Benefit: When you gain this feat, choose one office ability that you can use to affect no more than one opponent. If you successfully hit an opponent in combat (either with a weapon or an unarmed strike), in addition to dealing normal damage, you can use a swift action to deliver the effects of the chosen ability to that opponent. Doing so provokes no attacks of opportunity.

Special: You can take this feat multiple times. Each time you take it, you apply it to a different qualifying office ability.

Legendary Classes: Defenders of the Faith © 2024, Legendary Games; Jason Nelson, Aaron Hollingsworth, Amber Scott, Andrew J. Gibson, Carl Cramer, Clinton J. Boomer, Connor Bates, Jenny Jarzabski, Margherita Tramontano, Matt Daley, Nathan Reinecke, and Norman Mitchell Jr.
